description: This PHP source file sets the locale for a web UI based on the system's LANG environment variable, and contains code for handling user authentication, session management, and access control in a web interface for device management. It also includes functions for IP address detection and location categorization, along with user login handling and internationalization features.

methods.name: innerIP
methods.description: Determines if the client IP is within the internal network or container environment.

methods.name: get_ips
methods.description: Returns a list of IP addresses assigned to a specific network interface.

methods.name: if_type
methods.description: Categorizes the provided IP address as 'lan_ip', 'cm_ip', or 'rg_ip' based on network environment.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Initializes a user session, setting locale, timeout, and login user details.

methods.name: getAuthenticationUrl
methods.description: Constructs an OAuth authentication URL with redirect parameters.
